faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: After six and a half years and 163 episodes, History for Weirdos comes to an end.
kurzfassung: Andrew and Stephanie celebrate the final episode of their podcast after six and a half years by reading listener-submitted local lore and sharing personal updates. They discuss their upcoming first child, career milestones, and the future possibility of writing a book together. The hosts express deep gratitude to their community of listeners for years of unwavering support.
stichpunkte: The hosts celebrate 163 episodes, over seven million downloads, and six and a half years of the podcast.
Listeners share bizarre local lore and true crime stories from across the country.
Andrew and Stephanie share personal updates about expecting their first baby girl in October.
Andrew discusses his official entry into the Catholic Church.
The hosts reflect on their careers, including Stephanie's therapy practice and Andrew's new job.
They discuss the possibility of co-authoring a history book in the future.
The podcast concludes with a heartfelt thank you to the loyal listener community.

clips.text: The hosts reflect on standout moments from the show, including interviewing Peter Weller and hearing how listeners incorporate the podcast into their daily routines with family and travel.

clips.hook: A mysterious disappearance near a haunted lake
clips.text: A story is shared about a middle school teacher who vanished without a trace after swimming in a remote body of water known for supernatural activity.

clips.hook: A chilling confession after a horrific crime
clips.text: A convicted axe murderer describes how he killed his wife after she admitted she never loved him, followed by the murder of her children.

clips.hook: A murder conviction thrown out due to prosecutorial misconduct
clips.text: A notorious criminal walks free from death row not because he was proven innocent, but because the state concealed evidence and cheated during the trial.

clips.hook: The shocking moment of discovering a pregnancy
clips.text: Stephanie recounts the breathless moment she called her husband into the bathroom after seeing positive results on a home pregnancy test.

beschreibung:
We answer some questions, we read hometown histories and we say our goodbyes. This is it, thank you to all you Weirdos who made this show so special. Until next time, adios!
